summary: Shreya Acquisition Group, a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its initial public offering (IPO) and private placement on May 8, 2026. The IPO comprised 11 million units (including 1 million over-allotment units) at $10.00/unit, raising $110 million gross. Each unit consists of one Class A ordinary share, one redeemable warrant (exercise at $11.50), and one right (entitling holder to one-fourth of a Class A share upon a business combination). Simultaneously, the sponsor purchased 191,750 private units at $10.00/unit for $1.9175 million. Proceeds will be held in trust pending an initial business combination. This is a routine SPAC IPO filing, not a special situation.
